'''Ayane Sakura''' (Japanese: '''佐倉 綾音''' ''Sakura Ayane'') is a Japanese voice actress for {{aniseries|PTS}} and {{aniseries|HZ}}.

==Biography==
Sakura was born on January 29, 1994, in {{wp|Ebisu}}, {{wp|Shibuya}}, {{wp|Tokyo}}, {{wp|Japan}}, and became an actress as an adult. She gained several small roles in {{aniseries|PTS}} before gaining her most notable role during {{aniseries|HZ}} voicing [[Orla]] of the [[Rising Volt Tacklers]].
